name: Handles & Drive Reads
summary: Warm up the handle, read a partner's signal on the drive, finish off the baseline, then attack the rim tired.

drills.name: Low-High Rhythm Dribbles
drills.summary: Change dribble height on a beat to own your rhythm.
steps: Stand in a low stance with the ball in your right hand.
Pound three low dribbles at knee height, then three high dribbles at waist height.
Keep the beat steady and don't look down.
Switch hands every 30 seconds.
Finish with a crossover between each low and high set.

drills.name: Partner Signal Drives
drills.summary: Drive and react to what your partner shows you.
steps: Start at the top of the key. Partner stands at the free throw line facing you.
Drive at your partner at game speed with your eyes up.
Partner shows one hand up for a pull-up, two hands up for a layup, or steps to a side for a crossover away.
Make the read before you reach the elbow, then finish the play.
Switch drive hands every 2 minutes.

drills.name: Baseline Drive Finishes
drills.summary: Attack the baseline and finish with the right hand on the right side.
steps: Start on the right wing with the ball.
Jab, then take one hard dribble to the baseline.
Two dribbles max to the rim. Finish with your right hand.
Next rep, finish on the far side of the rim as a reverse.
Switch to the left wing after 2 minutes and use your left hand.

drills.name: Half-Court Attack Intervals
drills.summary: Sprint the ball to the rim and finish while your legs are tired.
steps: Start at half court with the ball.
Speed dribble to the rim and finish with a layup.
Grab the ball and backpedal to half court.
Repeat for 30 seconds, then rest 30 seconds.
Do 4 rounds. Alternate finishing hands each rep.
